verdict.rationale: Zapier documents natural-language operation through its official MCP server: users describe what they need in plain language, and the connected AI calls the right Zapier action across 9,000+ apps and confirms what it did. Zapier Copilot also helps users create agents that perform tasks. Missing for 10: natural-language control of the core Zap-building and management experience beyond agent creation (Copilot is only thinly described), parsing that depends on an external AI client rather than Zapier itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Describe what you need in plain language. Your AI calls the right Zapier action and confirms what it did.
Schedule a meeting with one prompt. Your AI finds time on everyone's calendar and books it.
It lets your AI take real actions across 9,000+ apps and 40,000+ actions, such as sending messages, creating tasks, and updating records
Create specialized agents—with the help of Zapier Copilot—to connect to your business data and perform tasks across 9,000+ apps.
